# January metadata

```{r}
jan_metadata_everythingmod <- jan_metadata %>% 
  rename(
    SAMPLE = X
  ) %>% 
    mutate_all(as.character) %>%
  select(SAMPLE, sample_type, location_name, depth_category, depth, filter_type, lat, long, pH, site, year, temp, prok, eukCONC) %>% 
  filter(filter_type != "postPCR") %>% 
  filter(filter_type != "NA") %>% 
  filter(location_name != "Soupy background")

jan_metadata_modified <- jan_metadata_everythingmod %>% 
  mutate(DATASET = case_when(
    grepl("_GR_", SAMPLE) ~ "GR",
    grepl("Gorda", SAMPLE) ~ "GR",
    grepl("_MCR_", SAMPLE) ~ "MCR",
    grepl("AT5033", SAMPLE) ~ "EPR",
    grepl("Axial", SAMPLE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial")) %>% 
  filter(!year %in% c(2013, 2014, 2015, 2019)) %>% 
  filter(!depth_category %in% c("under plume", "plume top", "30m above", "above vent", "euphotic", "oxycline")) %>% 
  filter(!sample_type %in% c("incubation", "control")) %>% 
  #filter (filter != "GFF") %>% 
  filter(!filter_type %in% c("GFF", "Major")) %>% 
  filter(!SAMPLE %in% c("62_TAACAC_S14", "J2-1505-UFO-09")) %>% 
  #filter(SAMPLE != "62_TAACAC_S14") %>% 
  filter(!DATASET %in% c("GR", "EPR")) %>% 
  mutate(
    SAMPLE = SAMPLE %>% 
      str_replace("BSW", "Background")
  )

unique(jan_metadata_modified$SAMPLE)

regions   <- c("MCR","AXIAL")
locations <- c("Plume","ArrowLoop","WhiteCastle","MustardStand","ShrimpHole",
               "Shrimpocalypse","Rav2","LotsOShrimp","Anemone","BagCity","Gollum",
               "Diva","Mkr33","Mkr113","Background","Vixen","ASHES","IntlDist","OldManTree")

jan_metadata_everythingformatted <- jan_metadata_modified %>%
  mutate(
    depth = as.numeric(depth),
    pH = as.numeric(pH),
    temp = as.numeric(temp),
    prok = as.numeric(prok),
    eukCONC = as.numeric(eukCONC)) %>% 
    mutate(
    VentField = case_when(
      grepl("Axial", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial_Seamount",
      grepl("Piccard", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      grepl("VonDamm", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      grepl("EPR", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "EastPacificRise",
      TRUE ~ site 
    )
  )

up_janmetadata <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>% 
  mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>%
  group_by(merged_sampleid) %>%
  summarise(
    depth = mean(depth),
    pH = mean(pH),
    temp = mean(temp),
    prok = mean(prok),
    eukCONC = mean(eukCONC)) %>% 
  drop_na(merged_sampleid)

#location_metadat <- meta

#rdametadata <- sampletype_metadata %>% 
  


#write_csv(sampletype_metadata, file = "~/Documents/GitHub/AXMCR/sampletype_metadata_table.csv")

```





# Prepare MCR dataset

```{r}
df_fixed <- deepsea_18S_asv_FinalProduct %>%
rename(FeatureID = `Feature.ID`) %>%  # changed the name so the asv table and metadata table match
 rename(value = `SEQUENCE_COUNT`) %>% 
  rename(H2 = `H2.`)

new_MCR <- df_fixed %>%  # filtering out prokaryotes
  filter(DATASET == "MCR") %>% 
  filter(!Domain %in% c("Archaea", "Bacteria")) %>% 
#  filter(!Supergroup %in% c("Terrabacteria", "Archaea_X", "Bacteria_X", "CMS", "FCB")) %>% 
#  filter(!Phylum %in% c("Aquificae", "Euryarchaeota", "Proteobacteria")) %>% 
  filter(Type != "expTf") %>% 
  filter(Class != "Metazoa") %>% 
  filter(value >= 10)
# removed incubation data, i am only interested in shipboard and insitu samples
  #mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species))


mcr_ev <- new_MCR %>% 
  mutate(
    new_class = Class %>%
      str_replace("_X$", "_Unknown") %>%
      replace_na("Unknown")
  ) %>% 
   mutate(supergroup_final = case_when(
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Telonemia" ~ "Telonemia",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Stramenopiles" ~ "Stramenopiles",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Alveolata"     ~ "Alveolata",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Rhizaria"      ~ "Rhizaria",
    TRUE ~ Supergroup   # keep other supergroups as they are
  )) 

unique(mcr_ev$SAMPLE)
```


```{r}
axial_df_fixed <- axial_18S_asv_FinalProduct %>%
rename(FeatureID = `Feature.ID`) # changed the name so the asv table and metadata table match


axial_filtered <- axial_df_fixed %>% # filtering out prokaryotes
  filter(!Domain %in% c("Archaea", "Bacteria")) %>% 
 # filter(!Supergroup %in% c("Terrabacteria", "Archaea_X", "Bacteria_X", "CMS", "FCB")) %>%
 # filter(!Phylum %in% c("Aquificae", "Euryarchaeota", "Proteobacteria")) %>%
  #filter(Type != "expTf") %>% 
  filter(Class!= "Metazoa") %>% 
  filter(!DEPTH_CATEGORY %in% c("under plume", "plume top", "30m above", "above vent", "euphotic", "oxycline")) %>% 
  filter(value >= 10)

axial_20s <- axial_filtered %>% 
  filter(AXIAL.YEAR %in% c("AXIAL_23")) 


#length(unique(test_axial_20s$FeatureID))

axial_renamed <- axial_20s %>% 
  mutate(
    new_class = Class %>%
      str_replace("_X$", "_Unknown") %>%
      replace_na("Unknown")
  ) %>% 
   mutate(supergroup_final = case_when(
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Telonemia" ~ "Telonemia",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Stramenopiles" ~ "Stramenopiles",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Alveolata"     ~ "Alveolata",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Rhizaria"      ~ "Rhizaria",
    TRUE ~ Supergroup 
  )) %>% 
  rename(ProkConc = Prok_avg)
unique(axial_renamed$SAMPLE)
```



```{r}
mcr_ever <- mcr_ev %>% 
  rename(LOCATION = VENT) %>% 
  mutate(SAMPLETYPE = str_to_lower(SAMPLETYPE))

axial_new <- axial_renamed %>%

  rename(SAMPLETYPE = SAMPLE_TYPE) %>%
```

# Setting up for the vent-associated (hosted) taxa

```{r}
axmcr_taxon <- axmcr %>% 
  select(FeatureID, Taxon, Domain, Supergroup, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, new_class, supergroup_final) %>% 
  distinct()

length(unique(axmcr_taxon$FeatureID))
length(axmcr_taxon$FeatureID)

axmcr_df_w_site <- ax_df <- axmcr %>% 
  select(FeatureID, SAMPLE, value, SAMPLETYPE, SITE, COORDINATES, DEPTH, TEMP, pH, Perc, Mg, H2, H2S, CH4, LOCATION, DEPTH_CATEGORY, PRIMER, FLUID_COLLECTION, AXIAL.YEAR, EXPERIMENT, DOC..um., POC..um., TDN.um., Prok_min, Prok_mid, Prok_mid2, Prok_max, ProkConc ) %>% 
pivot_wider(names_from = SAMPLETYPE, values_from = value, values_fill = NA) %>% 
mutate(vent_assoc = case_when((vent > 0 & is.na(plume) & is.na(background))  ~ "vent_associated")) %>% 
  drop_na(vent_assoc)

length(axmcr_df_w_site$FeatureID)

axmcr_vent_assoc <- axmcr_df_w_site %>% left_join(axmcr_taxon) 
#  mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species))

head(axmcr_df_w_site)

length(unique(axmcr_vent_assoc$FeatureID))

axmcr_FeatIDs <- axmcr_vent_assoc  %>% 
select(FeatureID, vent_assoc) %>% 
filter(vent_assoc == "vent_associated") %>% distinct()

axmcr_combined <-  left_join(axmcr, axmcr_FeatIDs, by = "FeatureID") %>% 
 distinct() 

#axmcr_combined <- bind_rows(axmcr, axmcr_FeatIDs)

length(unique(axmcr_FeatIDs$FeatureID))

length(unique(axmcr_vent_assoc$FeatureID))

length(unique(axmcr_combined$FeatureID))
```

# Vent Field Column
```{r}
test_combined_axmcr <- axm %>% #axmcr_combined
   mutate(
    VentField = case_when(
      grepl("AXIAL", SAMPLE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial_Seamount",
      grepl("Piccard", SITE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      grepl("VonDamm", SITE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      TRUE ~ SITE 
    )
  ) %>% 
   mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species)) %>% 
  filter(LOCATION != "Soupy background") %>% 
  filter(!SAMPLE %in% c("AXIAL_23_138_J21501_Mkr113_UFO_vent_shipboard_sterivex_SHIPBOARD_18S", 
                        "AXIAL_23_154_J21505_Mkr113_SUPR_vent_F1206_PES02_INSITU_18S", 
                        "AXIAL_23_164_J21502_Mkr33_UFO_vent_F8_sterivex_INSITU_18S")) %>% 
  filter(filter_type != "GFF") %>% 
  mutate(
    SAMPLE = SAMPLE %>% 
      str_replace("BSW", "Background")) %>% 
  mutate(
    LOCATION = LOCATION %>% 
      str_replace("BSW", "Background")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    LOCATION = LOCATION %>% 
      str_replace("background", "Background")
  )

length(unique(test_combined_axmcr$FeatureID))
```

# Collapse duplicates
```{r}

regions   <- c("MCR","AXIAL")
locations <- c("Plume","ArrowLoop","WhiteCastle","MustardStand","ShrimpHole",
               "Shrimpocalypse","Rav2","LotsOShrimp","Anemone","BagCity","Gollum",
               "Diva","Mkr33","Mkr113","Background","Vixen","ASHES","IntlDist","OldManTree")
asv_site <- test_combined_axmcr %>% 
  mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location),
    total_sequences = as.numeric(value)
  ) %>%
  group_by(merged_sampleid, FeatureID, VentField, SAMPLE) %>%
  summarise(total_sequences = mean(total_sequences))
            #, .groups = "drop")

filler_data <- test_combined_axmcr %>% 
  select(SAMPLE, FeatureID, Domain, Supergroup, supergroup_final, Phylum, Class, new_class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, LOCATION, SITE, SAMPLETYPE, DEPTH,DEPTH_CATEGORY, FLUID_COLLECTION, vent_assoc, filter_type, Species_Annotation)

new_merged <- left_join(filler_data, asv_site, by = c("SAMPLE", "FeatureID"))
```

# Sample Type Venn Diagrams 

```{r}
venn_hexcodes <- paletteer_d("PNWColors::Bay")
print(venn_hexcodes)

venn_colors <- c("#0F85A0FF", "#EDD746FF",  "#ED8B00FF")

df4venn <- new_merged %>% 
  select(FeatureID, total_sequences, SAMPLETYPE)

sample_venn <- df4venn %>%
  group_by(SAMPLETYPE) %>%
  summarise(ASVs = list(unique(FeatureID))) %>% 
  deframe()

sampletype_venn <- ggvenn(sample_venn, fill_color = venn_colors)

sampletype_venn
```

# Finding vent only asvs

```{r}
test_vent_asvs <- new_merged %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(SAMPLETYPE) == 1, SAMPLETYPE == "vent") %>%
  ungroup()

test_vent_asvs_info <- new_merged %>%
  filter(SAMPLETYPE == "vent") %>% 
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    also_in_other_st = any(SAMPLETYPE != "vent")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

asvs_info <- new_merged %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    in_vent= any(SAMPLETYPE == "vent"),
    also_in_other_st = any(SAMPLETYPE != "vent")
  ) %>%
  filter(in_vent) %>%  # keep only ASVs present in Lake
  ungroup()

test_asvsInfor <- asvs_info %>% 
  filter(also_in_other_st == FALSE)

length(unique(test_asvsInfor$FeatureID))

ventonly_asv <- new_merged %>% left_join(test_asvsInfor) %>% 
  drop_na(in_vent)

length(unique(ventonly_asv$FeatureID))

   #   in_vent &  also_in_other_st ~ "nonvent",
   #   TRUE                           ~ "nonvent"
   # )
 # )

asvs_vent <- asvs_info %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      is.na(in_vent) == TRUE ~ "vent",
      in_vent == TRUE & also_in_other_st == FALSE ~ "resident",
      in_vent == TRUE & also_in_other_st == TRUE ~ "cosmopolitan",
      in_vent == FALSE ~ "cosmopolitan"
    )
  )

length(unique(asvs_vent$FeatureID))

axmcr_actual <- new_merged %>% left_join(asvs_vent, by = "FeatureID") %>% 
  mutate(status = case_when(SAMPLETYPE %in% c("plume", "background") ~ "cosmopolitan",
      TRUE ~ status))

vent_associated_ASVs <- asvs_vent %>% 
  pull(FeatureID)

vent_exclusive_ASVs <- ventonly_asv %>% 
  pull(FeatureID)
```

```{r}
# Donut plot for plume and background (non-vent)
plume_and_back <- new_merged %>% 
  filter(SAMPLETYPE != "vent") %>% distinct() %>% 
  mutate(donut_taxa = case_when(
  new_class %in% c("Dinoflagellata", "Ciliophora") ~ Order,
  TRUE ~ new_class
))

donutpandb <- plume_and_back %>% 
    group_by(Phylum, VentField, donut_taxa) %>% 
  summarise(total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
            total_sequences = sum(total_sequences))

#length(unique(donutpandb$FeatureID))



donutpandb <- donutpandb %>%
  group_by(VentField) %>%
  mutate(
    fraction = total_sequences / sum(total_sequences),
    new_taxa = if_else(fraction < 0.01, "Other", donut_taxa)
  ) %>%
  group_by(VentField, new_taxa) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sequences = sum(total_sequences),
    total_asvs = sum(total_asvs),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(VentField) %>%
  mutate(
    fraction = total_sequences / sum(total_sequences),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = c(0, head(ymax, -1))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
 mutate(
    new_taxa = factor(
      new_taxa,
      levels = names(new_palette)
    )
  )


bpdonutplot <- ggplot(donutpandb, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=4, xmin=3, fill= new_taxa)) +
     geom_rect() + scale_fill_manual(values = new_palette) + facet_wrap(~VentField, scales = "free") +
     coord_polar(theta="y") + # Try to remove that to understand how the chart is built initially
     xlim(c(2, 4)) + theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Background and Plume Taxa")
```

# Table for Total ASVs and Vent-exclusive ASVs and the Unknowns

```{r}
asv_level <- axmcr_actual %>%
  tidyr::unite(CLASS_ORDER, new_class, Order, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  tidyr::unite(PHYLUM_CLASS, Phylum, Class, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species),
    is_ventassoc = status == "resident"
  ) %>%
  group_by(FeatureID, supergroup_final, PHYLUM_CLASS, CLASS_ORDER, Species_Annotation, is_ventassoc, Order) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


summary_phylum_class <- asv_level %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS) %>%
  summarise(
    everything_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    resident_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID[is_ventassoc]), 
    everything_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences),
    resident_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences[is_ventassoc]),       
    amount_all_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"),
    amount_end_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc),
    amount_all_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"]),
    amount_end_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_resident_asvs = 100 * resident_total_asvs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_resident_seqs = 100 * resident_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_end_asvs = 100 * amount_end_asvs_NAs / resident_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_all_asvs = 100 * amount_all_asvs_NAs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_end_seqs = 100 * amount_end_seqs_NA / resident_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_all_seqs = 100 * amount_all_seqs_NA / everything_total_sequences
  )


summary_super <- asv_level %>%
  group_by(supergroup_final) %>%
  summarise(
    everything_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    resident_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID[is_ventassoc]),
    everything_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences),
    resident_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences[is_ventassoc]),
    amount_all_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"),
    amount_end_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc),
    amount_all_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"]),
    amount_end_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_resident_asvs = 100 * resident_total_asvs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_resident_seqs = 100 * resident_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_end_asvs = 100 * amount_end_asvs_NAs / resident_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_all_asvs = 100 * amount_all_asvs_NAs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_end_seqs = 100 * amount_end_seqs_NA / resident_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_all_seqs = 100 * amount_all_seqs_NA / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_resident_seqs = 100 * resident_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences
  )

write_csv(summary_phylum_class, file = "~/Documents/AXMCR/Summary_PhylumClass_Table_002.csv")

summary_order <- asv_level %>%
  group_by(CLASS_ORDER) %>%
  summarise(
    everything_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),

    everything_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences),
```

# Plot for Table 

```{r}
unknown_plot_df <- summary_phylum_class %>%
  select(
    PHYLUM_CLASS,
    percent_NA_all_asvs,
    percent_NA_end_asvs
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(percent_NA_all_asvs, percent_NA_end_asvs),
    names_to = "ASV_group",
    values_to = "percent_unknown"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_group = recode(
      ASV_group,
      percent_NA_all_asvs = "All ASVs",
      percent_NA_end_asvs = "Vent-exclusive ASVs"
    ),
    PHYLUM_CLASS = factor(
      PHYLUM_CLASS,
      levels = rev(sort(unique(PHYLUM_CLASS)))
    )
  )

# Plot
unknown <- ggplot(
  unknown_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = percent_unknown,
    y = PHYLUM_CLASS,
    color = ASV_group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "All ASVs" = "#4472C4",
      "Vent-exclusive ASVs" = "#F5C710"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Unclassified ASVs Across Taxonomic Groups",
    x = "Unclassified ASVs (%)",
    y = "Phylum:Class",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 22
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )
```

# Heat map for Deeply Branching Taxa

## Proper heat map

```{r}
#library(pheatmap)
deeply_tax <- deeply %>%
  group_by(new_class, LOCATION) %>%
  summarise(nums = sum(total_sequences), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = LOCATION,
              values_from = nums,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("new_class") %>%
  as.matrix()

#deeply_tax_clr <- decostand(deeply_tax, method = "clr", na.rm = TRUE, pseudocount = 1)
#deeply_tax_rclr <- decostand(method = "rclr")
deeply_tax_clr <- clr(deeply_tax + 1)
#deeply_tax_rclr <- rclr(deeply_tax)


row_order <- hclust(dist(deeply_tax_clr))$order
col_order <- hclust(dist(t(deeply_tax_clr)))$order

#df_long$new_class <- factor(df_long$new_class,levels = rownames(deeply_tax_clr)[row_order])

#df_long$LOCATION <- factor(df_long$LOCATION,levels = colnames(deeply_tax_clr)[col_order])

df_ventfield <- deeply %>% 
  select(LOCATION, VentField)

df_long <- as.data.frame(deeply_tax_clr) %>%
  rownames_to_column("new_class") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -new_class,
               names_to = "LOCATION",
               values_to = "CLR")

heatmap_df <- df_long %>% left_join(df_ventfield, by = "LOCATION")

# Use this
ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(x = LOCATION, y = new_class, fill = CLR)) +
  geom_tile() + facet_wrap(~ VentField, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2C7BB6",
    mid =  "white", #"#FFFFEB",
    high = "#FF681F",
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 32),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 32),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 40),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 40),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 34),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 32),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 48),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 36)
  ) + labs(x = "Location", y = "Class", title = "Heat Map of Deeply Branching Taxa")
```

# Heatstrip


```{r}

sampletype_metadata <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>% 
  mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>%
  group_by(merged_sampleid, sample_type, VentField) %>%
  summarise(
    depth = mean(depth),
    pH = mean(pH),
    temp = mean(temp),
    prok = mean(prok),
    eukCONC = mean(eukCONC)) %>% 
  ungroup()

heatstrip_info <- sampletype_metadata %>%
  transmute(
    merged_sampleid,
    pH,
    temp,
    prok,
    eukCONC,
    depth,
    VentField,

    log_prok = log10(prok),
    log_euk  = log10(eukCONC),

    # pH bins
    pH_range = cut(
      pH,
      breaks = seq(0, 14, by = 1),
      labels = as.character(1:14),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),

    # temperature bins
    temp_range = cut(
      temp,
      breaks = seq(0, 140, by = 10),
      labels = paste(
        seq(0, 130, by = 10),
        seq(10, 140, by = 10),
        sep = "-"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),

    # log prok bins
    log_prok_range = cut(
      log10(prok),
      breaks = seq(4, 5.5, by = 0.5),
      labels = c("4.0-4.5", "4.5-5.0", "5.0-5.5"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),

    # euk concentration bins
    EukConc_range = cut(
      eukCONC,
      breaks = seq(0, 600, by = 50),
      labels = paste(
        seq(0, 550, by = 50),
        seq(50, 600, by = 50),
        sep = "-"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),

    # log euk bins
    log_euk_range = cut(
      log10(eukCONC),
      breaks = seq(1.0, 3.0, by = 0.5),
      labels = c("1.0-1.5", "1.5-2.0", "2.0-2.5", "2.5-3.0"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    
    # depth bins
    depth_range = cut(
      depth,
      breaks = seq(1000, 5000, by = 1000),
      labels = c("1000 - 1999", "2000 - 2999", "3000 - 3999", "4000-4999"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
matrix_heatstrip <- new_merged %>% 
  select(FeatureID, merged_sampleid, total_sequences) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = merged_sampleid, values_from = total_sequences, values_fn = mean, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "FeatureID") %>% as.matrix()

pca_clr <- prcomp(data.frame(compositions::clr(t(matrix_heatstrip))))

variance_clr <- (pca_clr$sdev^2)/sum(pca_clr$sdev^2)

barplot(variance_clr, main = "Log-Ratio PCA Screeplot", xlab = "PC Axis", ylab = "% Variance", 
        cex.names = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.5, cex.main = 1.5)
```

```{r}
  select(PC1, PC2, SAMPLE) %>%
```

```{r}
#install.packages("ggdendro")
#library(ggdendro)

# distance between samples
heatstrip_dist <- dist(t(matrix_heatstrip), method = "euclidean")

# cluster
heatstrip_cluster <- hclust(heatstrip_dist, method = "complete")

# set as dendrogram object
dend <- as.dendrogram(heatstrip_cluster)


labels_pH <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_temp <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_counts <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_euks <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_depth <- as.character(labels(dend))

sample_order <- c("AXIAL_Background", "AXIAL_ASHES", "AXIAL_Anemone",  "AXIAL_BagCity", "AXIAL_Diva", "AXIAL_Gollum", "AXIAL_IntlDist", "AXIAL_Mkr113", "AXIAL_Mkr33", "AXIAL_Vixen", "MCR_Background", "MCR_ArrowLoop",  "MCR_LotsOShrimp", "MCR_MustardStand", "MCR_OldManTree", "MCR_Plume", "MCR_Rav2", "MCR_ShrimpHole", "MCR_Shrimpocalypse", "MCR_WhiteCastle")  

label_order = factor(sample_order, levels = sample_order)
#label_order = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = merged_sampleid)

anno_pH <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(pH, pH_range, merged_sampleid, temp, temp_range, VentField) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_pH) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(merged_sampleid = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = sample_order)) %>%
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%
  mutate(pH_range = factor(pH_range, levels = pH_levels))

anno_temp <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(pH, pH_range, merged_sampleid, temp, temp_range, VentField) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_temp) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(merged_sampleid = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%   # alphabetical
  mutate(temp_range = factor(temp_range, levels = temp_levels))

anno_counts <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(pH, pH_range, merged_sampleid, temp, temp_range, VentField, log_prok_range, log_prok) %>%
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_counts) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(merged_sampleid = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%  # alphabetical order
  mutate(log_prok_range = factor(log_prok_range, levels = proklog_levels))


anno_euks <- heatstrip_info %>% 
select(eukCONC, EukConc_range, merged_sampleid, VentField, log_euk, log_euk_range) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_euks) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(merged_sampleid = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%  # alphabetical order
 #mutate(EukConc_range = factor(EukConc_range, levels = euk_levels))
  mutate(log_euk_range = factor(log_euk_range, levels = euklog_levels))

anno_depth <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(depth, depth_range, merged_sampleid, depth, depth_range, VentField) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_depth) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(merged_sampleid = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%   # alphabetical
  mutate(temp_range = factor(depth_range, levels = depth_levels))
```

```{r}
    mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(merged_sampleid)) %>%
  distinct(merged_sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type    = ifelse(is.na(sample_type), "Unknown", sample_type),
    location_name  = ifelse(is.na(location_name), "Unknown", location_name),
    VentField      = ifelse(is.na(VentField), "Unknown", VentField)
  )
```

```{r}
    breaks = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), limits = c(0,1)

  theme(

    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, size = 18),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

all_bc_plot
```

# Phyloseq for Vent-Exclusive ASVs
## Metadata for phyloseq

```{r}
metadata_quick <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>%
    mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(merged_sampleid)) %>%
  distinct(merged_sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type    = ifelse(is.na(sample_type), "Unknown", sample_type),
    location_name  = ifelse(is.na(location_name), "Unknown", location_name),
    VentField      = ifelse(is.na(VentField), "Unknown", VentField)
  )
```



# Average values for RDA
```{r}
metadata_quicker <- metadata_quick %>%
  group_by(site, sample_type) %>%
  mutate(pH = if_else(is.na(pH),
      mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
      pH)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
    group_by(site, sample_type) %>%
  mutate(temp = if_else(is.na(temp),
      mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
      temp)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
    group_by(site, sample_type) %>%
  mutate(prok = if_else(is.na(prok),
      mean(prok, na.rm = TRUE),
      prok)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(site, sample_type) %>%
  mutate(eukCONC = if_else(is.na(eukCONC),
      mean(eukCONC, na.rm = TRUE),
      eukCONC)) %>%
  ungroup()

#write_csv(metadata_quicker, "~/Documents/AXMCR/metadata_quicker.csv")

#write_csv(shared_df, "~/Documents/GitHub/AXMCR/shared_ASVs.csv")
```

```{r}
metadata_noNAs <- metadata_quicker %>% 
  select(merged_sampleid, depth, temp, pH, prok, VentField) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  drop_na()

meta_num <- metadata_noNAs %>%
  select(merged_sampleid, depth, temp, pH, prok)

meta_cat <- metadata_noNAs %>%
  select(merged_sampleid, VentField)

keep_sample_all <- metadata_noNAs$merged_sampleid
keep_sample_all

all_seq_count_wide <- new_merged %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% keep_sample_all) %>% 
  select(FeatureID, merged_sampleid, total_sequences) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = FeatureID,
    values_from = total_sequences,
    values_fill = 0,
    values_fn = mean
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "merged_sampleid")


meta_stand <- meta_num %>%
  column_to_rownames("merged_sampleid") %>%
  as.matrix()

meta_stand <- decostand(meta_stand, method = "standardize")

meta_stand <- data.frame(meta_stand) %>%
  rownames_to_column("merged_sampleid") %>%
  left_join(meta_cat, by = "merged_sampleid") %>%
  column_to_rownames("merged_sampleid")


meta_stand$VentField <- factor(meta_stand$VentField)


#levels(meta_stand$VentField)[levels(meta_stand$VentField) == "Axial_Seamount"] <- "Axial Seamount"

#levels(meta_stand$VentField)[levels(meta_stand$VentField) == "MidCayman_Rise"] <- "Mid-Cayman Rise"

all_seq_counts_clr <- compositions::clr(all_seq_count_wide)

rda_clr_mcr <- rda(all_seq_counts_clr ~ depth + temp + pH + prok + VentField, data = meta_stand
)

summary(rda_clr_mcr)


# ANOVA tests
anova.cca(rda_clr_mcr)

anova_test <- anova.cca(rda_clr_mcr, by = "term")

anova_test

plot(

)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
  summarise(total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
```

```{r}
  group_by(VentField) %>%
  mutate(
    fraction = total_sequences / sum(total_sequences),

    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n=-1))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Donut plot for vent-exclusive taxa
vent_donuts <- axmcr_actual %>% 
  mutate(donut_taxa = case_when(
  new_class %in% c("Dinoflagellata", "Ciliophora") ~ Order,
  TRUE ~ new_class
)) %>% 
  select(FeatureID, donut_taxa, status, total_sequences, LOCATION) %>% 
  filter(status == "resident")
  

vent_donuts <- vent_donuts %>% 
    group_by(donut_taxa, LOCATION) %>% 
  summarise(total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
            total_sequences = sum(total_sequences))

vent_donuts_two <- vent_donuts %>%
  group_by(LOCATION) %>%
    group_by(LOCATION) %>%
    mutate(
    fraction = total_sequences / sum(total_sequences),
    new_taxa = if_else(fraction < 0.01, "Other", donut_taxa)
  ) %>% 
    group_by(LOCATION, new_taxa) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sequences = sum(total_sequences)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    fraction = total_sequences / sum(total_sequences),
    #percent = paste0(round(100 * fraction, 1), "%"),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n=-1))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>% 
 mutate(
    new_taxa = factor(
      new_taxa,
      levels = names(new_palette)
    )
  )

num_taxa <- vent_donuts %>%
  group_by(LOCATION) %>%
  summarise(
    num_of_taxa = n_distinct(donut_taxa)
  )


donut_ventexplot <- ggplot(vent_donuts_two, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=4, xmin=3, fill= new_taxa)) + 
geom_rect() + scale_fill_manual(values = new_palette) + facet_wrap(~ LOCATION) +
     coord_polar(theta="y") + # Try to remove that to understand how the chart is built initially
     xlim(c(2, 4)) + theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Vent-exclusive Taxa")

donut_ventexplot
ggsave("donut_ventexplot.svg", width = 20, height = 10, device = "svg", limitsize = FALSE)
```
